plan.title: Awarded Event Edit Evaluation Time Disabled

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event directly on the RFQ Responses screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case before accessing the event.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu containing Edit Evaluation Time.
Assert that Edit Evaluation Time is greyed out.
Hover the disabled menu item to reveal its explanatory tooltip.
Assert that the product displays a tooltip explaining why the action is unavailable.
Try the disabled action and assert that no dialog or other UI opens.
